The target [9, 0, 9] is the center of the 2x2x4 green concrete structure (blocks span x=8-9, z=8-9, y=-1 to 2 spawn-relative). max_distance=5 ensures the player has actually approached the target (not just walked in the general direction), and facing_tolerance=60 ensures they are looking at it. The sandbox test confirmed the agent reached this distance within 20 steps.

scene_description: A cleared flat grass area (41x41 blocks) with a prominent 2x2x4 green concrete structure placed at ~8 blocks from spawn in the +X/+Z direction. A small cobblestone structure and an oak tree serve as visual landmarks/distractors. The player must navigate across the clearing to find and approach the green concrete blocks.
task_text: Find the green concrete blocks in the environment. Navigate toward them until you can clearly see them.
design_notes: The scene uses a large air fill to clear natural terrain, then places grass as the floor. The green concrete is a 2x2 footprint, 4 blocks tall structure at relative (8-9, -1 to 2, 8-9) from spawn — approximately 11 blocks diagonal distance from the player. The cobblestone at (-5,-1,2) and oak tree at (3,-1,-3) provide visual variety without blocking sightlines. The stone brick pad at spawn helps orient the player. The agent successfully navigated to the green concrete in the sandbox test within 20 steps.
